basic_info.description: This spacious 1-bedroom condo with a versatile den is a great value in one of the most sought-after neighborhoods. Offering a unique combination of modern elegance and luxurious comfort, it features radiant-heated stained concrete floors, a Carrera marble gas fireplace, built-in cabinetry with a functional office space and in-unit laundry. The open kitchen boasts brand-new stainless steel appliances and seamlessly flows into the living and dining areas, perfect for entertaining. Oversized windows fill the space with natural light, while the cozy fireplace adds extra warmth. The peaceful bedroom overlooks a serene courtyard, providing a relaxing retreat. With a dedicated parking space and unbeatable location just steps from Trader Joe's and a block from the North Beach library, pool, and playground. This condo offers great value and opportunity.
